summary: In Developer > Topology, open the <installation-name>-backstage deployment, Resources > View logs, then the Logs tab and pick the install-dynamic-plugins init container; success shows 'Successfully installed dynamic plugin ...' for each plug-in. The Environment tab lists container environment variables.
questions: How do I view install-dynamic-plugins logs in the console?
What does a successful portal plug-in install log look like?
